name: Ecuador (1830–1835)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and red, with an oval seal in the centre bearing a sun, mountains and the inscription 'El Ecuador en Colombia'.
history: Provisional flag of the State of Ecuador decreed on 19 November 1830, shortly after Ecuador seceded from Gran Colombia: the Gran Colombian tricolour was kept, with a new oval seal in the centre proclaiming 'El Ecuador en Colombia'. It was replaced in 1835, when the plain tricolour was adopted by law.

features.role: seal of the State of Ecuador ('El Ecuador en Colombia')
